entries.043e00913431f5c4: This business model operates schools concentrated in Kanagawa Prefecture, providing classes for elementary and junior high school students and high school students, and after-school childcare, and earns income from tuition and other fees.
entries.052bef8e59fb5d38: Under the concept of 'a cram school that energizes children,' its basic management policies include focusing exclusively on cram school operations and concentrating management resources in its specialist field, concentrating schools within Kanagawa Prefecture, and continually pursuing higher quality in lesson content and systems. As its medium- to long-term approach, the company states that it alternates every few years between periods focusing on opening new schools and periods focusing on strengthening internal operations, aiming to grow while maintaining the quality of lessons and operations. For the fiscal year ending September 2026, it states that it will take a restrained approach to opening new schools and operate as a period focused on adding classes at fully enrolled schools and raising seat occupancy rates. In the medium term, it identifies as challenges building a network of schools in Kawasaki City and in districts of Yokohama City where it has not yet expanded, such as Tsurumi, Naka, Minami and Kanazawa wards.

entries.5b570b9b8d40f701: This is a regionally focused cram school that operates exclusively as a cram school business, with 167 schools located only in Kanagawa Prefecture. The number of students was 36,744 at the end of September 2025, and the period average was 35,126, surpassing 35,000 for the first time. It has both an elementary and junior high school division and a high school division, and also runs after-school childcare on an integrated basis.
entries.5cbb5f00c1343378: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥15,846 million, an increase of 5.0% from the previous fiscal year. The elementary and junior high school division accounted for ¥12,520 million and the high school division for ¥3,326 million.
entries.62b66e8d65f59127: In the spring 2025 public high school entrance examinations, 1,367 students passed at eight of Kanagawa Prefecture's priority schools for academic improvement and advancement, and at seven of those schools the company ranked first in the number of passers by cram school. The company's students accounted for 52.7% of all successful candidates at the eight schools. In university entrance examinations as well, the number of current high school students who passed national and public universities in total reached 410, a new record high. Its track record of developing students, centered on public high school students in Kanagawa Prefecture, underpins the evaluation of its exam guidance.
